decisions.decisionRequired: Choose denominator window and sales basis
decisions.why: Snapshot and period sales must be aligned explicitly
decisions.recommendedDefault: Net invoiced revenue for an explicit month; null for zero denominator

decisions.decisionRequired: Define cash collections, dates, refunds and unallocated receipts
decisions.why: Settlement includes offsets and credits, not just cash
decisions.recommendedDefault: Posted inbound customer cash receipts; show applied and unallocated separately

decisions.decisionRequired: Choose invoice start, payment end, partial weights and unsettled handling
decisions.why: Cash application and payment date can differ
decisions.recommendedDefault: Amount-weighted applied cash days; partial allocations weighted; unpaid excluded and disclosed

decisions.decisionRequired: Define gross/net payable scope, credits and advances
decisions.why: Net supplier exposure differs from unpaid bills
decisions.recommendedDefault: Separate gross vendor-bill residual from credits/advances and ledger net

decisions.decisionRequired: Choose calendar month or rolling 30 days and missing due treatment

decisions.decisionRequired: Approve invoice-match timing, taxes and valuation bases
decisions.why: Goods quantity differs from financial accrual and sales value

decisions.decisionRequired: Define what the cost means and allocation to agency/invoice
decisions.why: Shipment, messaging and correspondence costs are different expenses

decisions.decisionRequired: Choose financial credits versus physical returns and denominator cohort
decisions.why: Returns can cross periods and stock/credit events need not coincide

decisions.decisionRequired: Choose contractual schedule or forecast and included liabilities
decisions.why: Forecast probabilities and committed liabilities produce different cash outlooks

decisions.decisionRequired: Approve expense scope, recurring source, plan version and accrual/cash basis

decisions.decisionRequired: Approve ledger versus available balances, restricted cash and liability horizon

decisions.decisionRequired: Approve account mapping, recognition, inventory method and allocations

decisions.decisionRequired: Approve PO commitment versus posted purchase accounting and discount baseline
